-- A calendar scaffold of the midnights before t (UNNEST of generate_series), equi-joined to
-- the stats recompute of each midnight. The scaffold includes the midnight of t's own day,
-- so the WHERE keeps only midnights strictly before t: at a midnight t, the recompute
-- stamped t is not known yet.
WITH scaffold AS (
    SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
           unnest(generate_series(date_trunc('day', l.label_ts) - INTERVAL 7 DAY,
                                  date_trunc('day', l.label_ts),
                                  INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS midnight
    FROM labels l
),
daily AS (
    SELECT sc.user_id, sc.label_ts, sc.churned, sc.midnight, s.total_spend AS v
    FROM scaffold sc
    LEFT JOIN user_stats s
      ON s.user_id = sc.user_id
     AND s.updated_at = sc.midnight
    WHERE sc.midnight < sc.label_ts
)
SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned,
       MAX(v) - MIN(v) AS total_spend_range_7d,
       COUNT(v)        AS n_snapshots_seen
FROM daily
GROUP BY user_id, label_ts, churned

-- dbt layering: staging rename, intermediate point-in-time pick, mart. The chosen snapshot
-- has snapshot_at < label_ts - lag_days <= label_ts, so it is known at t.
WITH spine AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts, churned
    FROM analytics.marts.fct_training_spine
),
stg_stats AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           updated_at  AS snapshot_at,
           total_spend AS lifetime_spend,
           n_orders    AS lifetime_orders
    FROM analytics.staging.stg_user_stats
),
int_stats_as_of AS (
    SELECT sp.user_id, sp.label_ts, st.lifetime_spend, st.lifetime_orders
    FROM spine sp
    JOIN stg_stats st
      ON st.user_id = sp.user_id
     AND st.snapshot_at < sp.label_ts - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.user_id, sp.label_ts
                               ORDER BY st.snapshot_at DESC) = 1
)
SELECT sp.user_id, sp.label_ts, sp.churned,
       a.lifetime_spend,
       a.lifetime_orders,
       a.lifetime_spend / NULLIF(a.lifetime_orders, 0) AS avg_order_value
FROM spine sp
LEFT JOIN int_stats_as_of a
  ON a.user_id = sp.user_id AND a.label_ts = sp.label_ts

-- One timeline of spine rows (at label_ts) and purchases (at ingested_at). Spine rows sort
-- before purchases at an equal timestamp (ord), and the ROWS frame ends at the current row,
-- so only purchases with ingested_at < t are summed.
WITH timeline AS (
    SELECT user_id, label_ts AS ts, 0 AS ord, churned, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS amt
    FROM labels
    UNION ALL
    SELECT user_id, ingested_at AS ts, 1 AS ord, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS churned,
           CAST(1.0 AS DOUBLE) AS amt
    FROM events
),
running AS (
    SELECT user_id, ts, ord, churned,
           SUM(amt) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, ord
                          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS loaded_total
    FROM timeline
)
SELECT user_id, ts AS label_ts, churned,
       COALESCE(loaded_total, 0) AS loaded_purchase_total
FROM running
WHERE ord = 0

-- The moving average looks only backwards (PRECEDING .. CURRENT ROW); the row picked has
-- updated_at < t, so every row in its frame is stamped before t.
WITH stats_smoothed AS (
    SELECT user_id, updated_at,
           AVG(total_spend) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY updated_at
                            ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma
    FROM user_stats
)
SELECT l.user_id, l.label_ts, l.churned,
       s.ma AS total_spend_trailing_ma6
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN stats_smoothed s
  ON s.user_id = l.user_id
 AND s.updated_at < l.label_ts
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.user_id, l.label_ts ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC) = 1

plan_known AS (

                               ORDER BY pv.valid_from DESC) = 1

    FROM tl

       hour(label_ts)      AS prediction_hour,
       date_diff('day', LAG(label_ts, 2) OVER w, label_ts) AS gap_since_prior_prediction,
       row_number() OVER w - 1 AS n_prior_predictions
FROM labels
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY label_ts)

           AVG(n_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY updated_at
                            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma
    FROM user_stats
)

       s.ma AS n_orders_trailing_ma2
FROM labels l
LEFT JOIN stats_smoothed s

 AND s.updated_at < l.label_ts

           user_id, label_ts, churned
    FROM analytics.marts.fct_training_spine

    SELECT s.spine_key, e.order_amount

    JOIN stg_events e
      ON e.customer_id = s.user_id
